authorization: User explicitly requested substantive missing calculations/data, supplementation and a final complete review on 2026-11-03. Earlier packages remain sealed.
question: Under common observation/qualification/return/budget rights, how do temperature-adapted conditional VAE-U-Net estimation and shared PPO scheduling change estimation accuracy, professional confirmation, age, costs and compute?

placement.test_scope: 12 master seed blocks x6 conditions =72 conditions, including healthy/spurious same-physics pairs; not72 independent processes
placement.phase_assignment: fully enumerated case_sets; seeded balanced permutation of the four phase values per split

task.agent_order: fixed ascending agent id for every method
task.candidate_space: original routine head plus owned pending events, subject to certificate/reservation/horizon/global remaining budget
task.physical_prior_input: current nominal-model temperature; no hidden truth/fault descriptors in inputs
task.critic_features: retained8 public value features plus remaining-extra fraction and pending-event fraction
task.greedy: all legal routine+event candidates maximize current public risk / quantized time-to-completion; ties routine first, then earliest visible request, then task index

estimator.name: temperature-adapted physics-residual conditional VAE-U-Net
estimator.checkpoint_selection: lowest development weighted temperature MSE, within each of three model seeds; no selection by test
estimator.inference: deterministic conditional prior mean; fresh measured temperatures replaced by same observation contract

ppo.architecture: shared MLP32x32 actor21 public candidate features / critic10 public global features; same architecture and initial seeds for nominal and CVAE
ppo.reward: existing observable ActiveInspection.step reward; no evaluator truth label or future anomaly end
ppo.rollout: one complete359-step episode per update, zero terminal bootstrap; never concatenate episodes
ppo.checkpoint_selection: fixed final120-episode checkpoint; no test-driven selection
ppo.training_case_order: fixed seed-shuffled balanced train case cycles; paired order and initial policy weights between nominal/cvae

statistics.independent_unit: master physical seed block,12 in final test; first average model seeds within each method and condition
statistics.zero_anomaly: confirmation_ratio and anomaly-conditioned wait are NA; report alarm/cue/normal closure separately
statistics.estimation_labels: physical rack_temperature, never biased public_sensor_temperature; recorded offline at matching360 endpoints
statistics.comparison: FIFO/Greedy isolate estimator change; PPO estimator difference is joint trained-system change

limits.retries: A failure halts its phase and is retained; an engineering correction requires a recorded amendment, not replacement test seeds or unreported automatic retries.

scale.scope: physical-process only measured runtime/memory plus static protected-tour feasibility, not an unexecuted large-rack learned-policy claim

timing.estimator_total_ms: public packet+nominal observer update+(neural grid prep+prior-mean prediction+fresh correction when neural); logger-only nominal grids excluded and separately recorded
timing.neural_predict_ms: real data conversion+device copy+prior-mean forward+return copy with CUDA synchronization
timing.policy_total_ms: public value/candidate preparation and selection; critic value evaluated only in stochastic training, not test
timing.online_control_cycle_ms: walltime from public choice preparation through one env.step, including measurement/execution bookkeeping, next-observation estimator and event lifecycle; excludes precomputed physical-trace generation, recorder copies, I/O and evaluator
timing.not_additive: estimator stage is contained in env.step; do not add it a second time to cycle
timing.reported_latency_phase: final test only;5 synthetic public-input warmup forwards per loaded neural checkpoint, excluded and counted separately

analysis.unit: within each seed block first average model seeds per condition, then average four primary conditions; bootstrap12 blocks. Healthy/spurious separate.
analysis.estimation_primary: not-freshly-observed weighted RMSE difference on the same retained Nominal-Tour public observation stream; identical fresh-correction contract for all three neural models
analysis.na_rules: case confirmation ratio/wait NA if no evaluation intervals; no missing value replaced by0; mean conditional wait over defined cases with denominator reported; R2 NA when physical-target SST<=1e-12
analysis.training_uncertainty: show three model-seed results and SD/range; bootstrap interval is physical-seed-block variation after model averaging, not a claim of complete training uncertainty
analysis.test_selection: no test-driven selection, additions, reruns or hyperparameter changes
